watch.summary: A streamer laughs hysterically when a player gets caught seconds into a hide-and-seek match after running straight into the seeker.

beats.what: Streamer notes the timer and says 'I'm cooked'.
The seeker is spotted searching nearby.
The player runs past the tables right into the seeker's face.
The player gets caught instantly with an in-game scream.
Streamer breaks into uncontrollable wheezing laughter.

watch.author: game_itself
watch.why: The sudden turn directly into the enemy creates an instant, slapstick fail. The creator's wheezing, contagious laughter elevates the funny visual payoff.
